title: Perch: sources for the loaded and diff tabs (/hub/meta)
what:
As pass 1:
- GET /hub/meta/tools: `eidolon [--config C] tools`, parsed as a stream -> [{name, approval, plugin?, first description line}], cached 10 min, never --live
- GET /hub/meta/plugins: {text}, capped
- GET /hub/meta/policy?mode=auto|manual|yolo:
  - {mode, file as a ~ path, rows: `policy-rows` text}
  - plus guard {on, file, why?} from guard::status() (S0P-a's stub until G1)
  - after G1, auto and yolo name the guard file
- GET /hub/meta/connectors: {mneme, melete} booleans only, never URLs or token paths
- GET /hub/meta/home: {default_mode, source}
- GET /hub/meta/git?session=<id>: the branch or detached sha from <cwd>/.git/HEAD (following a gitdir file), without running git; cwd from tree::base
tests:
tests/meta.rs:
- exact argv with --config and never --live
- a second GET inside the TTL starts no child
- connectors never contain http or token
- mode=manual uses config-manual.toml
- policy carries the guard object (stub: on false)
- git HEAD cases: a branch, a detached HEAD, a worktree .git file, no repo (branch:null), and a .git symlinked outside the root (refused)
- 401 without a token
live_check: fake perch on PORT=48109 + curl. X0 checks the shape of real `eidolon tools` output.
risk: Stock command text is shown verbatim and may change between eidolon versions.
